Stephen Kanti Mahanty is a junior at Harvey Mudd College studying engineering. He is currently taking ENGR 155 and has an interest in electrical and computer engineering. Last Summer, he worked at Argonne National Lab as an Electrical and Communications Engineering intern with the Transportation and Power Systems (TAPS) division. He has experience with PCB design, wireless networking and benchmarking, and automotive engineering. He also leads Harvey Mudd's premier robotics club, MuddSub. Outside of school and work, he likes to cook, read, and play Geoguessr.
